reels.hook: Slab dhalai se pehle cover block check kiya kya?
Waterproof PP shuttering sheet se barish aur keechad mein bhi site ka kaam chalu rakhiye.
Slab dhalai ke baad jaldi de-shuttering karne se concrete kamzor ho sakta hai. Sahi time par hi shuttering kholein.
Slab dhalai mein cover block miss mat kijiye! Sahi cover aur PP shuttering sheet se milti hai majboot finish.
Kya barish mein dhalai karni chahiye?
Barish aur keechad mein bhi site ka kaam nahi rukega jab aap use karenge waterproof PP shuttering sheet.

images.hook: Slab, beam, column: sab VAJRA PP shuttering sheet se. Swipe karke dekho 👉
Itna moda, phir bhi toota nahi. Lachila PP.
Site pe lagao, kaam shuru. Column aur slab dono.
Sariya cage taiyaar, phir PP panel se column band.
